title: Structural error: non-Decision operand of all
status: Proposed, hand-derived acceptance expectation. Not produced by any PPL compiler or evaluator. The experimental I1 compiler (libs/pathway-language) now checks the compile and preview blocks; no evaluator exists yet.

diagnostics.message: all requires Decision operands; found enum AssertionValue (Stage A 4.3, 10.1 step 4)

trace.because: An enum literal is not a Decision; there is no implicit coercion. Enum literals are typed only inside a query criterion over a candidate field
